rows.name:
From joint data of Ponspector survey, Wanawana
determine exact coordinates of Golden Shroom!
Once everypon back, a-treasure-hunting we go!

Look upon elegant swimming form of Tsukuku! Tsukuku
measure and find treasure, but beauty of Tsukuku is
immeasurable! Glance in mirror can tell you that!

One day after survey, Dodora spy BIRD PERSON!
So Dodora trail and find...Bird Capital Achamoth?!
EYES OF SURPRISE! Must make hat of feathers!

First expedition was little bit scary. Rutoru so
cute, almost smothered by Kromar fan club...
Was tough job, but Rutoru finish it like pro!

Sky Mole: Small, wing-like appendages on back.
Attempt to unfold produce small squeak.
Green Feris: Strong hind legs = powerful jump?

>Dear Chief, how can team be out of paint for
stake? Appalling state of affairs! Please to have
ready along with today's travel fees. - Setichi

Whew, that hard day's work! But Nanana take it
in stride after 5 years' service in Ponspector biz.
Gold license around corner! Nanana so pumped!

S-somebody! Anybody! Hachocho finish survey task
but now most precious charm is nowhere to find!
What to do?!?! Hachocho meltdown imminent!!!

Noino carry out sworn plan, only to encounter
One Untidy! Could break Final Limit and fight off,
but not before knave seal way to Original Proof...

Rocks of Pillar Knoll make such beautiful curve!
Torotoro working on monster-repellent incense
in spare time. Full disclosure after test run!

Shiishii ponspect from snack-time to home-time.
Incidentally, snack of today is Morrow Cob! Each
kernel packed with tasty sweetness... Mmmeh...

Unini knew he forget something: meet spot!
Chief forget to tell us. Again. Now total mayhem!
Except, Unini is equally to blame for forget...

Golden Shroom all shrivelled up, but still found
decent stash of loot! Archaeology Centre soon
back up on feet again, thanks to help of friends!
